description: Use the Mass Filter visual in your Power BI reports to let users filter other visuals on one of your columns/measures with a list of keywords. The advantage of the Mass Filter is that your users can copy a list of keywords from any external source (Excel, CSV, plain text file...), and paste it in the input box. When they click on the filter buttons, all values are used at once to filter the report instantly. That's it! No intermediate steps needed. The user can switch between inclusive (In) or exclusive (NotIn) filter by clicking on predefined button.
